purpose: Teach: 炸裂/廃墟/米兵/不毛/飢餓/自決/滅亡/査察

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、爆発物が炸裂した現場を警察、保全されましたね
lines.en: So the police have secured the scene where the explosives detonated, correct?
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful phrasing. Even tone, like laying out facts for confirmation. Slight pause before the question tag, checking for alignment. Academic precision without coldness.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、廃墟での違法行為を警戒します
lines.en: The police are monitoring for illegal activity in the ruins.
lines.style: Formal, procedural delivery. Matter-of-fact, neither defensive nor apologetic. Clear enunciation on key terms. Professional distance maintained throughout.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、駐留米兵関係の事案も警察、ご対応ですね
lines.en: And I understand the police are also handling the matter involving the stationed US military personnel?
lines.style: Careful, diplomatic phrasing. Slightly slower pace. Gentle rise at the end, inviting confirmation. Aware of sensitivity but not tiptoeing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、不毛な論争を避けて事実に基づき捜査します
lines.en: The police are conducting the investigation based on facts, avoiding unproductive debate.
lines.style: Calm assertion of principle. Steady, unflinching tone. Slight emphasis on 'facts'—not argumentative but clear about priorities. Professional resolve.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、飢餓状態に陥った被害者を警察、保護されますね
lines.en: The police are providing protection for the victims who fell into critical condition, I take it?
lines.style: Gentle but direct concern. Lower register on 'critical condition,' conveying weight. Question tag soft but genuine. Humane without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の自決を防ぐ警備にも配慮します
lines.en: The police are also taking precautions to prevent the suspect from taking their own life.
lines.style: Quiet gravity. Slow, deliberate pacing. Each phrase separate, conveyed with careful responsibility. No rush—this is serious work being stated plainly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、組織が滅亡する前の駆け込み犯罪を警察、警戒されてますね
lines.en: The police are vigilant about the possibility of desperate crimes before the organization collapses entirely, yes?
lines.style: Analytical but tense. Recognizing urgency beneath composure. Question inflection suggests shared understanding of risk. Intellectual precision with underlying urgency.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、国際査察団との連携を強化します
lines.en: The police are strengthening coordination with international inspection teams.
lines.style: Decisive, forward-looking. Firm commitment in the delivery. Slight emphasis on 'strengthening' and 'international'—showing resolve and scope. Closing statement clarity.
